test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The witness was reluctant to part ____ vital information.
solution:
The correct answer is '**with**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**with**" is used when referring to the act of parting or separating from something.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the witness was hesitant to part **with** vital information, indicating reluctance in sharing or giving up something.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **4** are grammatically incorrect and do not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The witness was reluctant to part **with**__ vital information."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "by"** is incorrect because "part by" does not convey the intended meaning in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "of"** is incorrect because "part of" implies belonging to something, which does not fit the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "from"** is incorrect because "part from" is not appropriate when referring to reluctance in sharing information.
